verdict.rationale: Railway's own site says it sends alerts via Slack, Discord, or email the moment user-specified conditions are met, which covers chat or email notification on custom conditions. The only evidence is that single homepage sentence, alongside custom metric dashboards. missing for 10: in-depth docs on alert configuration (which metrics or conditions, thresholds, routing), any detail on the email and chat channel setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set up alerts that notify me via chat or email when specific conditions are met

citations.quote: Slack, Discord, or emails the moment conditions you specify are met.
